logp.method_description: Partition coefficients of the complexes were determined in duplicate in an n-octanol/water system. Each complex was dissolved in 1.5 mL of water at 7 × 10- 5 M and subsequently an equal volume of n-octanol was added. The mixtures were shaken mechanically for 24 h to assure the distribution between the two solvent phases. The samples were centrifuged (13,000 rpm for 5 min). Afterwards, they were diluted 50-fold and the copper concentration was determined in both phases by graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometry (GFAAS) in a Varian model Zeeman AA 240 spectrophotometer equipped with a graphite tube atomizer and an autosampler. Results are expressed as apparent partition coefficients (P), which were determined from the total metal concentration in n-octanol divided by the total metal concentration in the aqueous layer.
